subject: mb-3-cs-b15-app1-data-flow
intent: Show the booking flow's three round trips and the payment paths including the D5 late-payment shadow, so the reader trusts that one transaction guards the slot and money never moves on the browser's word. The load-bearing claim: confirm_booking re-checks slot, resource and places inside the same transaction that confirms, and a late webhook either reinstates inside that discipline or refunds in full (design doc section 22 row 4; section 14.8 D5).
type_reason: The RT1-RT2-RT3 ordering and the webhook's later arrival are the meaning; vertical order carries the D5 shadow path.

node_roles.customer-browser: the customer choosing and paying; nothing trusted from it
node_roles.booking-flow-form: the client form; caches context between steps
node_roles.get_booking_context: round trip 1 - services, providers, intake schema
node_roles.get_available_slots: round trip 2 - only genuinely free slots
node_roles.confirm_booking-transaction: round trip 3 - slot, resource and places re-checked inside the same transaction
node_roles.gateway-payment-session: the hosted payment; card data never touches the instance
node_roles.webhook-log-row: the event's index and processing state
node_roles.process-webhook-task: the background task that applies the event once
node_roles.d5-refund-path: the late-payment shadow - reinstate inside the transaction, or refund in full

quality_gate: showcase accepted only at 9 artifact checks, 0 composition errors, 0 warnings
abort_conditions: the D5 shadow colliding with the main path's lifelines
